ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (cream-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-contrast white contiguous blobs located on the distal half of each lobe, separated by a wide black central corridor. Black linear streaks and mottling are superimposed on the white regions, particularly prominent on the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle approximately between 30 and 45 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to its opening width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged protrusions and extreme variations are localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderate convex curve from the median notch to the lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tips and scattered along the upper sections of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the white ventral sections; notably, three prominent near-parallel vertical lines on the right lobe and shorter diagonal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiont (barnacle) colonization at the lobe tips and multiple linear rake-mark scars cutting through the ventral pigmentation mapping.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme jaggedness and volumetric irregularity of the right lobe tip due to dense barnacle accumulation creates a unique structural silhouette.
